Bill.BriefDescription: Providing funds to ensure waste tires are disposed of properly.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tire recycling; amending RCW 70.95.510; addingnew sections to chapter 70.95 RCW; and repealing RCW 70.95.530,70.95.535, and 70.95.540.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.95.510 and 1989 c 431 s 92 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is levied a ((one)) three dollar per tire fee on theretail sale of new replacement vehicle tires ((for a period of fiveyears, beginning October 1, 1989)). The fee imposed in this sectionshall be paid by the buyer to the seller, and each seller shall collectfrom the buyer the full amount of the fee. The fee collected from thebuyer by the seller, less the ten percent amount retained by the selleras provided in ((RCW 70.95.535)) subsection (3) of this section, shallbe paid to the department of revenue in accordance with RCW 82.32.045.All other applicable provisions of chapter 82.32 RCW have full forceand application with respect to the fee imposed under this section.The department of revenue shall administer this section. (2) For the purposes of this section, "new replacement vehicle p. 1 SB 6262tires" means tires that are newly manufactured for vehicle purposes andused tires available for resale, but does not include retreaded vehicletires. (3) Every person engaged in making retail sales of new replacementvehicle tires in this state shall retain ten percent of the collectedthree dollar fee. The money retained may be used for costs associatedwith the proper management of the waste vehicle tires by the retailer.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The vehicle tire recycling account is created within the statetreasury. Funds collected under RCW 70.95.510 shall be deposited inthe vehicle tire recycling account. Expenditures from the account mayoccur only after appropriation by the legislature. The department ofrevenue shall deduct two percent from the funds collected under RCW70.95.510 for the purpose of administering and collecting the fee fromnew replacement tire retailers.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Funds in the vehicle tire recycling account shall be expended forthe sole purpose of ensuring waste tires, as defined in RCW 70.95.550,are recycled in an environmentally responsible way. The department ofecology shall administer funds in the account by awarding competitivegrants to recyclers of tires and licensed waste tire transporters whotransport waste tires from a collection point to a recycling plant.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 70.95.530 (Vehicle tire recycling accountUse) and 1988 c250 s 1 & 1985 c 345 s 7; RCW 70.95.535 (Disposition of fee) and 1989 c 431 s 93; and RCW 70.95.540 (Cooperation with department to aid tirerecycling) and 1985 c 345 s 9.
